decisions.statement: The sources an app is built from are read from its page.
A workstation that is not a mac hands the build to a mac.
No app's web directory is delivered, since the mac builds that directory.
A build reporting no sentinel counts as nothing installed.
The delivered tree's root is named to the build, since the shell sits under it.
What the build installs is the range each package the app's page reaches.
The script making an app's native sources is named to the build by its path.
Nothing the build says is reported until the build has finished.
Each thing this writes is named as soon as that thing reaches a machine.
A run that threw part way names those things in its refusal.
A run that refused part way names them as a run that threw does.
The running this does is handed in.
Nothing here uploads to App Store Connect.
The plugins the build compiles in are the packages the app's page reaches.

definition: one iOS app built on the mac and installed on a simulator there
